text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) has 
arrived—the race to determine the 
strongest middle-distance runner, Senior 
Class included—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is gonna win today! And then 
she'll achieve the first-ever Tenno Sho 
spring-autumn double! Man, I really wanna 
witness history in the making!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way, today's Oguri Cap's day! The 
"Monster" from the regional circuit is 
definitely gonna take down Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Well now. The crowd's already all fired 
up before the race even started, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I win with this, Tokyo Racecourse might 
just explode from the heat, don'tcha 
think? Now that'll be a sight to see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's no good. I won't be able to race 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's just a figure of speech! Don't 
go makin' a face like you just got lost in 
the woods!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want to lose the ability 
to race—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hah! What's with all that "I won't be able 
to" nonsense? You didn't need that lame 
buildup when you were raring to go from 
the very start.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“—Bring it on, Oguri Cap. I, Tamamo Cross, 
the ‘White Lightning,’ am gonna blow past 
you with everything I've got!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...The air feels heavy. This very 
pressure is the presence of those hailed 
as the strongest "right now"—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I can't contain my excitement even before 
running. I want to experience that 
strength up close as soon as possible...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, myself included. To the supreme 
stage where the peak of "now" gathers—
